metaTitle: Camping Cot Size and Weight Capacity
description: Understand cot weight ratings, length and width, frame materials and tent fit, and pick a camping cot with the right margin for your weight.
directAnswer: Cot capacity is a static rating, usually 250 to 600 pounds. Choose a rating 50 to 100 pounds above your weight plus gear, a length 6 inches over your height and a width that suits how you sleep.
